panel.title: DM quick actions
panel.randomUnitsHint: Free allied units (under the DM) are distributed among the players

refresh.title: Refresh from the library?
refresh.description: Abilities, attacks, spells, slots, DC and speed of the participants are refreshed from the campaign database. HP, morale, effects and used limits stay.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.saveEnds: Saving throw at the end of the turn

awaiting.descriptionVictory: The visible enemies are defeated. Bring the reserve into the battle or end the battle?
awaiting.descriptionDefeat: The visible allies are defeated. Bring the reserve into the battle or end the battle?

complete.title: End the battle?
complete.description: Pick the result or let it be decided automatically by the victory conditions.

log.title: Battle log
log.rollback: Undo the action (roll back to the state before it)
log.rollbackConfirm: Roll the battle back to the state before this action? This and all following actions will be deleted.

casterPicker.title: Cast a spell
casterPicker.description: Choose the participant who will cast the spell

addParticipant.title: Add a participant to the field
addParticipant.description: The participant takes a place in the queue by their initiative or waits in reserve.
addParticipant.reserve: To reserve — appears when the DM brings them into the battle

legendary.title: Legendary action: {name}
legendary.attackMissing: The ability's attack was not found

hints.walls: Click or drag along the edges; the first edge decides whether to place or remove
hints.teleport: Two cells make a pair; clicking a teleport removes the pair
hints.fog: Clicking toggles fog in the cell
hints.placeUnit: Click a cell for the unit
hints.awaitingExit: Click an edge cell for the new maze's exit

generate.title: Generate a maze
generate.description: New walls, teleports and fog; the heroes will stand at the edge.

descriptions.walls: The exit stays in place; nobody will be walled in.
descriptions.scatter: The exit stays in place; nobody will be walled in.
descriptions.tunnel: Enemies go to the DM's reserve and the rest of the map becomes one room. Heroes line up in a straight tunnel from the center to the edge; the exit moves to the end of the tunnel.
